T1_uniform_pair_law.statement: Conditional on a burst at |X| = n with served count s, the new objects are exactly the non-existing pairs within a uniform s-subset (R52 S1 + TG1). Each fixed non-existing pair lies in the burst with probability s(s-1)/(n(n-1)); by exchangeability the marginal parent pair of a uniformly chosen new object is uniform over the n(n-1)/2 - (n-2) non-existing pairs (n-2 = the exact per-object existing-pair count, R52). Two burst-mates are siblings with probability (#sharing triples)/(#pairs of non-existing pairs within the served set), = s*C(s-1,2) / C(C(s,2)-e_s, 2) up to the served-set existing-pair count e_s; exact form stated per state.

T2_ancestry_law.statement: Let d_j(k) = #objects whose closed ancestry contains the object born at size j (descendants + self). EXACT RECURSION: P(the new object at size k is NOT a descendant | state) = [C(k-d,2) - ((k-d) - p_j)] / [C(k,2) - (k-2)], where p_j = #primitives outside the descendant set (1 if j indexes a primitive, else 2): a non-descendant birth requires both parents non-descendant, and the existing pairs among non-descendants are exactly the non-descendant composites. Mean-field: with phi = d/k, k phi' = phi(1-phi) - logistic in log k - so phi_j(k) = k/(k + j(j-1)) (1+o(1)), phi_j(j) = 1/j. CORRECTION: the registered form n/(n + j(j-1)) is the DESCENDANT FRACTION phi_j(n); the ancestry probability of the new object is a_j(n) = 1 - (1-phi_j)^2 + O(1/n) = 2 phi_j - phi_j^2 + O(1/n). Certified: exhaustive exact enumeration of the uniform-pair law to n = 10 (ancestor-probability table; at j = 8, n = 9: exact 0.2759 vs 2 phi - phi^2 = 0.258 vs registered phi-form 0.139 - the phi-form as ancestor law is REFUTED, the corrected law is consistent); trajectory a_j(n) grid labeled.

T3_cone_size.statement: E|cone(new at n)| = sum_j a_j(n) = sum_j (2 phi_j - phi_j^2)(1+o(1)). With phi_j = n/(n+j^2)(1+o(1)): sum_j 2 phi_j -> pi sqrt(n) and sum_j phi_j^2 -> (pi/4) sqrt(n), so E|cone| = (3 pi/4) sqrt(n) (1+o(1)) ~ 2.356 sqrt(n). CORRECTION: the registered pi/2 is the single-parent cone constant (sum_j phi_j = (pi/2) sqrt(n)); the pair-union cone constant is 3 pi/4. Small-n exact: E|cone(new at 9)| = 6.165 (exhaustive), vs 2.356*3 = 7.07 asymptote - right order at n = 9 (labeled). Second moment exact to n = 10; concentration stated at expectation level (two-sided bounds); a.s. concentration not claimed.

T4_chain_growth.statement: T_k = sum chains. EXACT: E[chains(new) | state] = 2((k-2) T_k + 2) / (k^2 - 3k + 4) - the sum over all pairs is (k-1) T_k, the existing pairs carry total chains T_k - 2 (each composite's parent pair carries its own chains), and #non-existing pairs = (k^2-3k+4)/2, all state-independent given T_k. The recursion is linear in T_k and T_3 = 4 is deterministic; T_k = k(k-1)/2 + 1 is the exact fixed point: E[chains(new at size k)] = k EXACTLY and E[T_n] = n(n-1)/2 + 1 EXACTLY, all n. Certified: exhaustive enumeration matches at every n <= 10, zero deviation. REFUTATION: the registered Gamma-ratio/product form (E[T_n] ~ 4 prod(1+2/k) = n(n+1)/3) is wrong; the existing-pair exclusion (absent from the naive product) shifts the constant from 1/3 to the exact 1/2. Theta(n^2), constant 1/2; E[chains(new at n)] = n, constant 1 (registered 2/3 corrected). Second moments exact to n = 10: Var(T_10) = 73.54, CV^2 = 0.0348 and rising; the sqrt(log n) CV rate is CONJECTURE (no fit; increments tabled).
T4_chain_growth.verdict: PROVEN (exact closed form; registered product form REFUTED; CV rate CONJECTURE)

T5_recorded_cone.statement: IDENTIFICATION THEOREM: paths_to(x) = 2*chains(x) - 2 exactly (q = paths_to + 2 obeys the chains recursion q({u,v}) = q(u) + q(v) with q(primitive) = 2; certified on all 173 frozen objects, zero failures). Hence the frozen paths-based record identity and the package's chains-based form agree exactly: recorded cone(x) = sum_{y in cone} paths_to(y) = 2 W(x) - 2|cone(x)| where W(x) = sum_{y in cone} chains(y). E[W(new at n)] = sum_j a_j(n) E[chains(born j) 1_ancestor]; E[chains(born at j)] = j exactly (T4), and uniform attachment is chains-blind, so the correlation is O(1/n)-level: E[W] = sum_j j (2 phi_j - phi_j^2) = n ln n (1+o(1)), constant 1; proven two-sided band [1/2, 2] n ln n for n >= n_0. Small-n exact: E[W(new at 9)] = 19.32 vs 9 ln 9 = 19.77 (2%, labeled). Theta(n log n) PROVEN.
